text: Environments — dev, test, and prod. The single most common early mistake is skipping this entirely.
One workspace for everything means no separation between changing something and it going live. Three workspaces, moved between with lesson 15's deployment pipeline, is the fix.

Dev has small sample data and relaxed permissions. Test has production-shaped data with prod-level permissions. Prod has the real thing. But the KQL and eventstream logic itself stays identical across all three.
Dev and test never touch real production data — a bug in an untested query could write into a table real dispatchers are watching. Production-shaped data is realistic, but safe to break.
Same logic everywhere, different data and permissions underneath. Next up: CI/CD — automating the move between these environments instead of doing it by hand.
